find_placeholders_in_text: use Placeholder.finditer to find all NG_ARG placeholders in a text string
replace_placeholders_in_text: use Placeholder.sub to replace NG_ARG placeholders in text with provided values
symlink_folder_tree: use symlink_folder_tree to create a lightweight symlink copy of a folder tree
instantiate_folder_with_params: use FolderInstantiator to instantiate an instrumented folder with parameter values into a temp directory
run_parametrized_folder_function: use FolderFunction to turn an instrumented folder into a callable function that runs a command
